summary: Afya Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and related proxy materials. The filing includes the meeting date (June 22, 2026), record date (May 15, 2026), and an ordinary resolution to approve financial statements and the auditor's report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No special situation or corporate action is disclosed; this is a routine notice for an annual shareholder meeting. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other event-driven special situation.
